source_title: Do Sugar And Red Meat Cause Cancer? Cancer Doctor Reveals Early Signs Most Indians Ignore | Doctor vs Internet - India Today
source_excerpt:
Why are cases rising in India, and how do you catch it early? In this episode of Doctor vs Internet, Sonal Mehrotra Kapoor speaks with Dr Archit Pandit, Director of Surgical Oncology at Fortis Escorts, about what’s really driving cancer in India and what you can do about it.
• Why cancer cases are rising in India • Why obesity is a leading cause of cancer after tobacco • The estrogen, fat and cancer link in women • Early warning signs: lumps, mouth ulcers that don’t heal, voice change, reflux, bleeding mistaken for piles, changing moles • Does sugar cause cancer? Is red meat the problem? What to eat instead • Cancer patterns by regions in India: paan masala, charred meat, air pollution • Mammogram: when to start, cost and radiation myths • How a stage 0 cancer was caught early through a colonoscopy • Mindset, meditation and life after cancer
Gift a mammogram this Diwali. Early detection saves lives.
